'''Near Indosa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Near Indosa system/Legends|Near Indosa system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] connected it to the [[Presbalin system/Legends|Presbalin]] and [[Trinovat system/Legends|Trinovat systems]], and another, smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Far Indosa system/Legends|Far Indosa system]].<ref name="TEA" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] existence, which [[Declaration of a New Order|ended]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Near Indosa had been [[Mining/Legends|mined]] for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], leaving its upper crust riddled with ancient tunnels. The world had been depleted of most of its valuable resources by that time, and after the economically promising worlds of the Far Indosa [[Star system/Legends|system]] were opened for mining during those years, the majority of Near Indosa's [[Miner/Legends|miners]] relocated there.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Near Indosa was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
